arxiv-2102-10772.title: UniT: Multimodal Multitask Learning with a Unified Transformer
arxiv-2102-10772.creator: Ronghang Hu Amanpreet Singh
arxiv-2102-10772.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ronghang Hu Amanpreet Singh. We propose UniT, a Unified Transformer model to simultaneously learn the most prominent tasks across different domains, ranging from object detection to natural language understanding and multimodal reasoning. Based on the transformer encoder-decoder architecture, our UniT model encodes each input modality with an encoder and makes predictions on each task with a shared decoder over the encoded input representations, followed by task-specific output heads. The entire model is jointly trained end-to-end with losses from each task.

arxiv-2209-09693.title: CLIO: a Novel Robotic Solution for Exploration and Rescue Missions in Hostile Mountain Environments
arxiv-2209-09693.creator: Michele Focchi, Mohamed Bensaadallah, Marco Frego, Angelika Peer, Daniele Fontanelli, Andrea Del Prete, Luigi Palopoli
arxiv-2209-09693.description: Abstract Rescue missions in mountain environments are hardly achievable by standard legged robots—because of the high slopes—or by flying robots—because of limited payload capacity. We present a concept for a rope-aided climbing robot which can negotiate up-to-vertical slopes and carry heavy payloads.

arxiv-2310-15787.title: SequenceMatch Revisiting the design of weak-strong augmentations for Semi-supervised learning
arxiv-2310-15787.creator: Khanh-Binh Nguyen
arxiv-2310-15787.description: Abstract Semi-supervised learning (SSL) has become popular in recent years because it allows the training of a model using a large amount of unlabeled data. However, one issue that many SSL methods face is the confirmation bias, which occurs when the model is overfitted to the small labeled training dataset and produces overconfident, incorrect predictions.

arxiv-2412-00043.title: Classification of monads and a new moduli component of stable rank 2 bundles on ℙ 3 \mathbb{P}^{3} with even determinant and c 2 = 9 c_{2}=9 .
arxiv-2412-00043.creator: Aislan Leal Fontes
arxiv-2412-00043.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aislan Leal Fontes. The goal of this paper is to classify all minimal monads whose cohomology is a stable rank 2 bundle on ℙ 3 \mathbb{P}^{3} with Chern classes c 1 = 0 c_{1}=0 and c 2 = 9 c_{2}=9 , with possible exception of two non-negative minimal monads, and thus we extend the classification of the minimal monads made by Hartshorne and Rao in [ 16 , Section 5.3] when c 2 ≤ 8 c_{2}\leq 8 .

arxiv-2502-10167.creator: Yun-Chih Chen, Tristan Seidl, Nils Hölscher, Christian Hakert, Minh Duy Truong, Jian-Jia Chen, João Paulo C. de Lima † \dagger, Asif Ali Khan, Jeronimo Castrillon † \dagger, Ali Nezhadi, Lokesh Siddhu, Hassan Nassar, Mahta Mayahinia, Mehdi Baradaran Tahoori, Jörg Henkel, Nils Wilbert, Stefan Wilderm
arxiv-2502-10167.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yun-Chih Chen, Tristan Seidl, Nils Hölscher, Christian Hakert, Minh Duy Truong, Jian-Jia Chen, João Paulo C. de Lima † \dagger, Asif Ali Khan, Jeronimo Castrillon † \dagger, Ali Nezhadi, Lokesh Siddhu, Hassan Nassar, Mahta Mayahinia, Mehdi Baradaran Tahoori, Jörg Henkel, Nils Wilbert, Stefan Wilderm. Abstract

Non-volatile Memory (NVM) technologies present a promising alternative to traditional volatile memories such as SRAM and DRAM. Due to the limited availability of real NVM devices, simulators play a crucial role in architectural exploration and hardware-software co-design.

arxiv-2505-09571.title: Don’t Forget your Inverse DDIM for Image Editing PubID: pubid: Corresponding author: Guillermo Gomez‑Trenado (guillermogomez@ugr.es)
arxiv-2505-09571.creator: Guillermo Gomez-Trenado 1 2, Pablo Mesejo 1, Oscar Cordón 1, Stéphane Lathuilière 3
arxiv-2505-09571.description: Abstract The field of text-to-image generation has undergone significant advancements with the introduction of diffusion models. Nevertheless, the challenge of editing real images persists, as most methods are either computationally intensive or produce poor reconstructions. This paper introduces SAGE (Self-Attention Guidance for image Editing) —a novel technique leveraging pre-trained diffusion models for image editing.

britannica-1911-fakir.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fakir.description: Article 'Fakir' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Dervish (q.v.) or Mahommedan religious mendicant, but which has come to be specially applied to the Hindu devotees and ascetics of India. There are two classes of these Indian Fakirs, (1) the religious orders, and (2) the nomad rogues who infest the country. The ascetic orders resemble the Franciscans of Christianity.

pmc-11505205.creator: Jana G. Weber, Ariana Ortigas-Vásquez, Adrian Sauer, Ingrid Dupraz, Michael Utz, Allan Maas, Thomas M. Grupp
pmc-11505205.description: The use of inertial measurement units (IMUs) as an alternative to optical marker-based systems has the potential to make gait analysis part of the clinical standard of care. pmc-12529091.title: Release study of microplastic fibres and heavy metals from disposable surgical face masks in aqueous medium: the effect of physio-chemical factors and shear forces
pmc-12529091.creator: Soupam Das, Anjali Shaw, M. R. Sumaiya, J. B. Jeeva, Amitava Mukherjee
pmc-12529091.description: Since the COVID-19 pandemic broke out, there has been a dramatic surge in the usage of disposable face masks, and even though the pandemic has passed, discarded masks persist in aquatic systems where they continue to release microplastic fibres. These masks are composed of plastic nonwoven fabrics and can potentially contribute polypropylene (PP) microplastics to the environment.

pmc-12803816.title: Effects of administration of a non-specific immunostimulant prior to mating on pregnancy establishment and fetal and placental development in mice
pmc-12803816.creator: Whitney Brown, Michaela Kuzniar, Sarah Retherford, Brooke Mitrisin, Allison Ingols, Jezaniah-Kira Tena, Susan C. Sucheta, Jeremy Block
pmc-12803816.description: Early embryonic mortality occurs in many mammalian species, including mice, humans and several livestock species. Previous work in mice has demonstrated a role for pro-inflammatory cytokines and immune cells in stimulating ovarian function and uterine receptivity during the peri-conception period. The objective was to determine if administration of an immunostimulant could improve pregnancy establishment and fetal survival.

pmc-13173835.title: Challenging diagnosis: prolidase deficiency presenting as nonhealing ulcers and pancytopenia complicated by gluten enteropathy—a case report
pmc-13173835.creator: Viplove Gupta, Vaibhav Yadav, Ved Prakash Pandey, Sanjay Dubey, Yogendra Jamra, Akash Pawar
pmc-13173835.description: BackgroundProlidase deficiency is a rare autosomal recessive metabolic disorder resulting from mutations in the PEPD gene, leading to impaired collagen turnover and a broad spectrum of clinical features. Its manifestations include recurrent ulcerative skin lesions, recurrent infections, and hematological abnormalities. Celiac disease, another multisystem disorder, presents with chronic diarrhea, malabsorption, and iron deficiency anemia.

pmc-13379097.description: Melioidosis is a life-threatening infectious disease caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei. Early and accurate diagnosis is critical for timely treatment and improved outcomes. Although highly endemic in tropical regions, it remains underdiagnosed due to limitations of current diagnostic methods. Bacterial culture, the diagnostic gold standard, is time-consuming, prone to misidentified species, requires specialized laboratory facilities, and has low sensitivity.
